Messages.Author: Matt Latham
Messages.Body:
I'm sure these are pretty basic, but...

1) Lets say I have superior Celerity and Superior Animalism. I use a flash
to manuever to long range with an optional press. I then strike with Aid
from Bats at superior. Lets say I use the flash press to continue combat. Do
I still have a maneuver and press to use in round 2 (from the aid from
bats?)

2) I block my predator's minion and we go to combat. He strikes with Dodge.
I strike with Scorpion Sting. Does this cancel the Dodge?

Thanks
Matt

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
"Matt Latham" <mla...@diamondtoolmfg.com> wrote:
>I'm sure these are pretty basic, but...
>
>1) Lets say I have superior Celerity and Superior Animalism. I use a flash
>to manuever to long range with an optional press. I then strike with Aid
>from Bats at superior. Lets say I use the flash press to continue combat. Do
>I still have a maneuver and press to use in round 2 (from the aid from
>bats?)

No. Maneuvers and presses from combat cards are only usable in the round
in which the combat card is played.

>2) I block my predator's minion and we go to combat. He strikes with Dodge.
>I strike with Scorpion Sting. Does this cancel the Dodge?

No. But the dodge is ineffective against the Scorpion Sting (which
amounts to almost the same thing).
